instruction: Access the 'Color' guidelines at https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/color, summarize the main guidance, and store it in a desktop file named 'color_design.docx' without including external resources or links.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG color page and saving content to docx. Evaluator checks for key terms related to color guidelines (color, design, interface, palette, visual), minimum word count of 100, and at least 5 paragraphs. Custom getter extracts document content and structure, custom metric validates keyword presence and document completeness. State-based evaluation without external ground truth.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 30% word count (>=100 words), 20% paragraph count (>=5 paragraphs), 50% keyword presence (5 key terms)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts document content, word count, and paragraph count using python-docx library
Metric logic correctly implements the scoring breakdown: 30% word count, 20% paragraph count, 50% keyword presence
Data flow is correct: getter extracts paragraphs/counts, metric performs case-insensitive keyword matching and threshold checks
Postconfig appropriately activates document window and saves file before verification
Expected values are semantically appropriate: keywords (color, design, interface, palette, visual) match Apple HIG color guidelines topic
Threshold values (100 words, 5 paragraphs) are reasonable for capturing 'essential content'
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks document existence, keyword presence, content length, and structure
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: evaluator cannot verify content source fidelity (whether content is actually from Apple HIG page vs any text with these keywords)
Minor limitation: evaluator cannot verify content filtering quality (whether external links/resources were properly excluded)
These are inherent limitations of state-based verification without ground truth, not fixable errors
